//: Where the apps come from. Each entry is a GitHub repository whose latest release carries .softn bundles. `kind: catalogue` reads the release's catalogue.json (softn-Examples); anything else takes every .softn asset and its SHA256SUMS.txt. `tag` pins a release instead of the latest. `category`, `tags` and `author` are what the directory files them under; the built-in examples keep the directory's own tables.
